## Shapes Generalize

Infer geometric shape classes from unlabeled point clouds and generalize under distribution shift.

Cluster and classify point clouds into five geometric shape categories. The published example explains hidden labels and six evaluation shifts.

## Published conditions

Hints allowed.

The task is counted once; hint variants are not separate problems. This entry records the actual current result-catalog family. Full runnable task assets are not provided by the public website.
